subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Plan, Solve, Check
objective: Solve one- and two-step addition or subtraction problems.
introduction: Identify what is known, choose operations, solve, and check the result against the situation. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: The number that comes first when counting.
Putting numbers together to find a total.
Taking away to find what is left.
